What HVAC technicians order

Built for the work

  • Embroidered polos and twill work shirts for service techs
  • Moisture-wicking tees for attic and summer install work
  • Quarter-zips, soft shells and vests for winter service calls
  • Caps and beanies with the company logo

Tips for hvac uniforms

  • Service techs going into homes look best in embroidered polos or button-up work shirts; install crews can wear printed tees.
  • Add the tech's first name above the pocket - customers remember a name.
  • Choose stain-resistant, easy-care fabrics for techs working around equipment.

Company orders

How crew and company orders work

1

Send your logo & headcount

Tell us the garments, colors and roughly how many people. Email your logo to meadowprintsembroidery@gmail.com - any file works.

2

Get a quote & proof

You get a quote and a digital proof within 24 hours. Volume pricing kicks in automatically on larger orders.

3

Send your size run

Send sizes (and names, if you want them stitched) as a simple list. Mixed sizes and tall sizes are fine.

4

Reorder any time

We keep your logo and order details on file, so restocking for new hires is one call or email.
